releaseNotes: V756 is a clean V723 rebase; V724/V725 startup/session invalidation changes are not carried forward.
Only stableEdgeDown with PortStateLocal.NoDevice marks the affected port as requiring fresh identity verification.
While that physical-edge flag is active, IDENTITY_REST_SESSION_LATCH is bypassed so stale REST identity cannot immediately re-latch the previous device.
The existing serial identity read publishes the replacement ProductName and clears the physical-edge flag after success.
No new REST refresh worker, generic connection-session invalidation, PortStatus hook, periodic identity polling, or timer-based retry is added.

en: Rebased cleanly on the verified V723 SMC startup-presentation build and added only physical cross-port hot-swap re-identification.

A confirmed physical NoDevice transition now blocks reuse of the previous REST ProductName latch for that port, forcing one fresh identity read through the existing SerialCommandQueue when the port reconnects.
The V723 SMC first-start logo/product-image replay path and IoddAutoDownloadService startup behavior are unchanged.
ko: 검증된 V723 SMC 최초 표시 기준본에서 다시 시작하여 물리 포트 교차교체 재식별 기능만 추가했습니다.
실제 NoDevice 전이가 확인된 포트만 이전 REST ProductName 세션 latch 재사용을 차단하고, 포트가 다시 연결되면 기존 SerialCommandQueue를 통해 identity를 1회 새로 읽도록 했습니다.
V723의 SMC 최초 시작 로고/제품 PNG replay 및 IoddAutoDownloadService 초기 동작은 변경하지 않았습니다.
